package.name: Urban Kicks Liquid
package.description: First-party Urban Kicks storefront converted to portable Liquid sections and blocks.

theme.source:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="{{ request.locale | default: "en" }}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>{{ shop.name }} - Urban Kicks</title>
  {{ content_for_header | raw }}
</head>
<body class="lb-theme lb-theme--urban-kicks">
  <main id="MainContent">
    {{ content_for_layout | raw }}
  </main>
  {{ content_for_footer | raw }}
</body>
</html>

typography.label: Typography
typography.description: First-party type settings mirrored from the JSON-contract Urban Kicks theme.

settings.text: Free shipping on fresh drops this week.

settings.heading: Fresh drops for daily buyers
settings.subheading: Launch-ready sneakers, apparel, and accessories for a commerce storefront.

settings.title: Drop-ready collection
settings.subtitle: Curated items for the first storefront launch.

settings.heading: A brand-new Liquid section
settings.subheading: Added as sections/spotlight.liquid without changing the storefront React registry.

settings.title: Get first access
settings.subtitle: Store updates, new drops, and offers sent to your inbox.

{{ section.settings.text }} {{ section.settings.linkLabel }}
